data.name: Heading
data.comment: The section's heading.

data.name: ResolutionLabel
data.comment: The resolution list's label.

data.name: FormatLabel
data.comment: The format list's label.

data.name: QualityLabel
data.comment: The quality list's label.

data.name: Checking
data.value: Checking what this PC can encode…
data.comment: Shown in place of the lists until the startup probe has said what this PC can encode.

data.name: Ready
data.comment: Said to a screen reader when the lists appear in place of Checking.

data.name: ConservativeNote
data.value: 10Lapse couldn't check this PC's video encoders, so it offers H.264 up to 1080p.
data.comment: The note when the probe failed or timed out. It stands in for EncoderCapabilities.Summary.

data.name: FormatReplaced
data.value: {0} can't be exported on this PC, so {1} is selected.
data.comment: A format was replaced because this PC cannot export it. {0}: the format's name ("HEVC"); {1}: the one selected now.

data.name: ResolutionReplaced
data.value: {0} can't be exported on this PC with these settings, so {1} is selected.
data.comment: A resolution was replaced because this PC cannot export it with the project's settings. {0}: the old one ("4K"); {1}: the new one.

data.name: ResolutionReplacedByShape
data.value: {0} isn't available for this shape on this PC, so {1} is selected. Your {0} choice comes back with a shape that allows it.
data.comment: A resolution was replaced because this PC cannot export it in the current frame shape; the choice returns with the old shape. {0}: the chosen one ("4K"); {1}: the one selected now.

data.name: KeepSelected
data.comment: The button under a replacement notice that stores the selected settings in place of the earlier choice.

data.name: EstimateAbout
data.comment: The estimate. {0}: the size from Size.

data.name: Megabytes
data.comment: A size in megabytes. {0}: the number.

data.name: Gigabytes
data.comment: A size in gigabytes. {0}: the number.

data.name: UnderOneMegabyte
data.comment: The estimate when the file stays under a megabyte.

data.name: ResolutionOptionFormat
data.comment: The list entry for a resolution. {0} its name ("1080p"), {1} the width, {2} the height, in pixels.

data.name: FormatOptionFormat
data.comment: The list entry for a format. {0} the codec ("H.264", "HEVC").

data.name: QualityStandard
data.comment: The quality list's lowest bitrate.

data.name: QualityHigh
data.comment: The quality list's default bitrate.

data.name: QualityMaximum
data.comment: The quality list's highest bitrate.
